_comment: EXAMPLE cue config for the Jev FL conductor. Copy to jev_fl_cue.json and fill track indices from the DUPLICATED test cue (never the production project). Track indices are FL mixer indices (0 = master). Presets are mute maps: 'mute' lists tracks to mute, 'unmute' lists tracks to unmute, applied via mixer_set_mute only. HOLD is always a no-op. Every index in presets must belong to a whitelisted stem group, else the bridge refuses the preset.

BUILD.note: Next authored layer on, resonance held back.

BLOOM.note: Atmosphere + resonance open around voice and groove.

RESTRAIN.note: Tension without the peak: air under voice, no resonance wash.
